object.attr: derived: a PDF that mixes the document at one commit with its parents or figures at another shows content and coverage that never existed, and a branch can move during an export, as MELLON-VER-SRS-66 found for Compare. Figures and the parents declared at that commit added (review Q35). A declared parent absent there is MELLON-PDF-SRS-173's case.
object.description: When Mellon exports a document at a version other than the working copy, Mellon shall read the document, its figures and its declared parent documents from the commit the version names at the export start.
